the sorption of LiCl on the surfaces of zinc, lead, or tin cyanoferrate crystals is accompanied by a decrease in the number of protons and a decrease in the concentration of the cyanoferrate anions in the sorption products.

the sorption of lithium chloride on the surface of the zinc, lead, tin cyanoferrate is accompanied by the formation of the corresponding hydroxides.
